fields.topology_type: Point-to-point single-host / single-device differential serial link per SATA port. Up to 32 ports per AHCI HBA, each independent. Each port can optionally fan out to up to 15 SATA devices via a Port Multiplier (PM). There is no shared-medium 'bus' anywhere in the fabric — every SATA link is dedicated.

supported_topologies.name: Single port + single SATA device
supported_topologies.description: Most common: one HBA port → one HDD / SSD / ATAPI ODD.

supported_topologies.name: Single port + Port Multiplier (CBS)
supported_topologies.description: Command-Based Switching: HBA addresses one PM port at a time via the PMP field of the H2D Register FIS.

supported_topologies.name: Single port + Port Multiplier (FBS)
supported_topologies.description: FIS-Based Switching: HBA tracks up to 16 concurrent device contexts per port; Received FIS Structure expands from 256 B to 4 KB; PxFBS.EN=1.

supported_topologies.name: Tiered AHCI + Bridge
supported_topologies.description: AHCI HBA + PCI-to-PCI bridge + a second AHCI HBA + Port Multiplier — supported per AHCI 1.3.1 Figure 1 (IA-Based System Diagram).

supported_topologies.name: Embedded multi-port server HBA
supported_topologies.description: Server chipset with 6, 8, 16, or 32 SATA ports — typical RAID front-end.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Initiates every SATA transaction; acts as bus master to system memory; manages OOB / speed negotiation / power management via per-port Link layer.
Responds to CFIS with one or more FISes (DMA Setup / Data / D2H Register / Set Device Bits); may initiate Asynchronous Notification via SDB FIS with N bit.
Routes FISes between one HBA port and 15 SATA devices; appears in PxSIG as 0xC33C0101; uses 4-bit PMP field in H2D Register FIS for routing.
Optional. Drives backplane LED / SES-2 / SAF-TE / SGPIO messages; appears in PxSIG as 0x96690101.

fields.interconnect_role: AHCI defines no protocol-level router. Each SATA link is independent and dedicated. Port Multipliers operate at the FIS level — they parse the H2D Register FIS PMP field and forward to the addressed device port; they cannot drop, split, or reorder FISes within a flow.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_fis: Dwords are transmitted in strict order; SOF / payload / CRC / EOF framing enforces atomic FIS delivery (or R_ERR).
ordering_guarantees.across_fises_same_command: Strictly sequential per command — DMA Setup / Data / D2H Register FISes for a single command arrive in the order the device transmits them.
ordering_guarantees.across_commands_ncq: NCQ commands may complete out-of-order — each completion is reported by a Set Device Bits FIS with the matching SActive bit; software is responsible for in-order semantics if needed.
ordering_guarantees.across_ports: No inter-port ordering — each port operates independently; HBA does not synchronize between ports.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: AHCI registers occupy a non-cacheable memory region behind PCI BAR5 (ABAR). System memory carries the Command List / Command Tables / PRDs / Received FIS Structures pointed to by PxCLB / PxFB. The HBA acts as a bus master to system memory; software cooperates by allocating buffers (1 KB aligned for Command List, 256 B / 4 KB aligned for FIS Receive area, 128 B aligned for Command Tables).

device_classification.ahci_hba: PCI / PCI-X / PCIe device implementing AHCI register set; Class Code 0x010601.
device_classification.sata_disk: HDD / SSD attached to one port; signature 0x00000101.
device_classification.port_multiplier: Fan-out to up to 15 devices; signature 0xC33C0101.
device_classification.enclosure_mgmt_bridge: Backplane LED / SES-2 / SAF-TE / SGPIO bridge; signature 0x96690101.
